title: Spartan wave 4 art
whats_new: Weapon art for the four wave 4 metals marked Good: Nexus Accelerite, Embers Dawnstone, Create Deep Dark Echo and Legendary Monsters Enderitium. Traits follow the wave 4 picks and are already coded. Thavma, Orevolution and IFMUP were dropped as marked. Enderitium is green because the mod's own ingot is green.

items.title: Nexus: Accelerite weapons
items.detail: Accelerite is the Nexus metal marked Good in round spartan-wave4-r1. Spartan's iron sprites recoloured to the mod's own charged accelerite ingot, same style as the approved wave 3 sets: all 24 kinds plus bow and crossbow states. Top row: vanilla iron sword, Spartan iron longsword, source ingot; then every kind at 1x and 4x. Trait coded: Overclock, each hit within 3 seconds raises attack speed 6%, up to 5 stacks, and hits at full stacks knock back (pick B). The module stays off by default until this art is Good.
items.ask: Good = ship these colours, Needs changes = say what to shift, Bad = drop the material.
